name: cua-hard/tahoe-offsite-closeout
description: Close out a team offsite's expense reports in Expensify as the approver: correct typed amounts to what the receipt images show, switch company-card items to non-reimbursable, attach an emailed receipt, reject an out-of-offsite and an already-reimbursed report, settle the host's paddleboard question on Airbnb, report the payout total to the controller in Gmail and write a per-report CSV.
